source_documents.sales_conversation: Customer: 'How long do you keep our data after termination?' Sales: 'We will retain your data for 90 days after termination for export.'
source_documents.contract_text: Section 7.3 Data Retention: Vendor shall retain Customer data for 90 days following termination, available for export.
